name: Example: Twilight Gravity
author: byo-pop examples
description: Bejeweled 2's Twilight: after each move that makes a match, the gems fall the other way, down and then up. The backdrop is mirrored and dimmed, the gems fall slower and the sounds play a little lower. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Gems fall
settings.help: Down, then up: Twilight, the direction changes after each move that makes a match. Up: always up.

settings.label: Fall speed
settings.help: How fast falling gems speed up. 75 slows falls as much as Bejeweled 2's Twilight does; the original is 180.

settings.label: Twilight backdrop
settings.help: The level's backdrop mirrored left to right at half brightness.

settings.label: Sound pitch (semitones)
settings.help: Every sound effect played this many semitones higher or lower.
